description: Provision of pharmaceutical products such as medicinal preparations, medicinal drugs, patent medicines, serums, vaccines, vitamins and minerals, cod-liver and halibut-liver oils, oral contraceptives. Includes provision of these products to outpatients only; pharmaceutical products provided to inpatients are classified under hospital services.
includes: provision of medicinal preparations, medicinal drugs, patent medicines, serums and vaccines, vitamins and minerals, cod-liver and halibut-liver oils, oral contraceptives, etc.
regulation and control of the production and distribution of pharmaceutical products
excludes: pharmaceutical products provided to inpatients (classified under hospital services 073x)
